_: THE TRAP (GDD 6). One strike collapses a shaft clean through, dropping you somewhere you did not choose. Not punishment -- CONSEQUENCE. Most digging games have no way to dig wrong.
_arithmetic: resistance 0.25 against a 1 HP pickaxe is deliberate: 1.0 - 0.25 x 4 = 0 breaks exactly four levels and stops with nothing left over. HP is continuous precisely so this is expressible (GDD 4.3.1).
_scope: pass_down carries the blow DOWN the tree, so one strike bores a full-depth hole rather than collapsing the whole 16x16. Collapsing sideways is pass_through, which Phase 0 authors as none (GDD 6).
